items.title: Ukraine strikes St Petersburg with over 1,000 drones
items.summary: Ukraine launched one of its largest drone attacks of the war on Sunday, sending over 1,000 drones toward St. Petersburg and striking a major oil export terminal and data center. The attack caused massive fires, knocked out power to thousands of residents, and was described by Russian state media as "one of the biggest drone attacks of the year." This escalation occurs amid tensions between the U.S. and Ukraine over military support and policy direction.

cards.title: The Power of Paternity Leave
cards.insight: Research shows that fathers who take paid parental leave report better mental health outcomes and stronger family bonds. Yet this option remains underutilized in most of America due to lack of federal policy, despite growing adoption in states with their own programs.
cards.takeaway: If available in your state or employer benefits, consider taking parental leave to boost your mental health and family connection—it's becoming more normalized and supported.

cards.title: Stress and School Safety
cards.insight: School shootings create lasting psychological trauma not only for survivors and families but also for entire communities, affecting students' ability to learn and feel safe. The emotional toll extends far beyond the immediate incident.
cards.takeaway: Support mental health resources in your community schools and advocate for comprehensive violence prevention programs that address both physical and psychological safety.

cards.title: Long-Term Marriage Health
cards.insight: Recent data reveals that many marriages end after 20+ years rather than at the stereotypical 7-year mark, suggesting that relationship health challenges evolve over time. This shift highlights the importance of sustained emotional connection and adaptation throughout a partnership.
cards.takeaway: Invest in relationship maintenance tools—counseling, communication workshops, or regular check-ins—especially in years 15–25 of marriage when new tensions may emerge.

cards.title: Drone Attacks and Civilian Anxiety
cards.insight: Large-scale military operations like overnight drone strikes create mass anxiety and disruption for civilian populations, including widespread power outages and displacement. The psychological impact of living under threat extends far beyond physical injuries.
cards.takeaway: If you live in or work with communities affected by conflict, prioritize access to mental health support and trauma counseling services for residents dealing with ongoing security threats.
